title: Move open (local) models behind an experimental flag and freeze them
description: User decision on 2026-10-09: open models are hard to manage well right now. Move everything related to them behind an experimental flag; unless it is on, nothing related to open models exists in the running app. Open-model development is frozen, freeing time for work such as ARA-088. The flag-off app uses only hosted OpenAI chat, embedding and reranking profiles. Lead check of the user's dev data: all 6 papers use the default OpenAI embedding profile and every assistant answer used a hosted model, so turning the flag off loses nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Given EXPERIMENTAL_OPEN_MODELS is unset or false (the default), when the app runs, then no open-model surface exists: no local chat models in /models or the composer, no Local models settings, no local embedding or reranker profiles, no model download, verify or delete endpoints or jobs, no local-model activity and no startup verification jobs.

Given the flag is off, when Compose starts with the documented command, then the Ollama and model-worker services do not run, readiness never depends on them, and existing model volumes and weights are untouched.
Given the flag is on, together with the documented Compose profile, when the app runs, then today's open-model behaviour returns unchanged.

Given stored state referencing open models (a saved local default, local-model history, a paper on a local embedding profile, a local reranker setting), when the flag is off, then history stays readable, nothing silently switches to a paid model, the user is asked to choose a hosted model, and retrieval settings resolve to hosted profiles.
Given the flag is off, when the backend and frontend suites run, then they pass, and the existing open-model tests still pass with the flag on in tests.
Given README and AGENTS.md, when read, then open models appear only in an Experimental section that states the freeze and how to enable them.
test_cases: Backend: catalogs, routes, jobs and readiness with the flag off and on.
Backend: a saved local default and a local retrieval profile with the flag off.
Frontend: settings, composer, Activity and Details hide open-model UI when the API reports the flag off.
Compose config check: profiles exclude ollama and model-worker by default.
verification: Planned on 2026-10-09 from the user's decision. Branch feat/ara-090-open-models-flag.
